% Derived from the documented PGF shadows library drop-shadow opacity example.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{shadows}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[help lines] (0,0) grid (3,2);
  \filldraw[drop shadow={opacity=1},fill=white]
    (1,2) circle (.5) (1.5,2) circle (.5);
  \filldraw[drop shadow={opacity=.25},fill=white]
    (1,.5) circle (.5) (1.5,.5) circle (.5);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
